content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "B-21 Raider (budget line B02100) is a U.S. Air Force procurement line funded in the Aircraft Procurement, Air Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d1f004919881e332"}}, {"text": "The line funds procurement of the B-21 Raider, the Air Force's next-generation strategic bomber, including aircraft flyaway costs, producibility improvements, support equipment, alternate mission equipment, training, spares, depot standup, and engineering change orders.", "citation": {"fact_id": "2598f582b2303d46"}}, {"text": "Funding may also address Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages (DMSMS) and obsolescence, through activities such as bridge buys, life-of-type buys, and buys to protect the production schedule.", "citation": {"fact_id": "2598f582b2303d46"}}, {"text": "The B-21 is a special-access program: it is reported to Congress in accordance with Title 10, United States Code, Section 119(a)(1) in the Special Access Program Annual Report, and detailed public justification is limited.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e3175556cf2d2604"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The line's total funding is $5,551,242 thousand (about $5.55 billion) requested for FY2026, up from $2,600,468 thousand enacted in FY2025.", "citation": {"fact_id": "473e68bd3c3640a3"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the line recorded actual spending of $2,270,693 thousand (about $2.27 billion), so the FY2026 request roughly doubles the recent execution level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a8cb19a7838209c0"}}, {"text": "The FY2026 request is split between a discretionary request of $3,452,116 thousand (about $3.45 billion) and a reconciliation (mandatory) request of $2,099,126 thousand (about $2.10 billion).", "citation": {"fact_id": "8b63088cef978beb"}}, {"text": "The mandatory (reconciliation) portion of the request is $2,099,126 thousand, a large share of the year's growth.", "citation": {"fact_id": "816009b0aa9b4074"}}, {"text": "The program's own justification states that the enhancement portion of the FY2026 request funds expansion of production capacity for the B-21, with further detail provided in Section 20008 of the Reconciliation Exhibit.", "citation": {"fact_id": "2598f582b2303d46"}}, {"text": "The near-doubling of the line signals a ramp toward full production of a new nuclear-capable strategic bomber, one of the Air Force's largest procurement commitments.", "citation": {"fact_id": "36d310773a87426b"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The line is run by the U.S. Air Force, with funding drawn from the Aircraft Procurement, Air Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d1f004919881e332"}}, {"text": "Because the B-21 is a special-access program, oversight and public reporting run through the Director of Special Programs in the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment (OUSD(A&S)/DSP).", "citation": {"fact_id": "e3175556cf2d2604"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
